column8: is_a parents (obo source fills OntologyTerm.parents).  The filter runs on the raw term, before the transform, and is not optional: in OWL, rdfs:subClassOf also points at anonymous class expressions (owl:Restriction, "part_of some X").  A full GO extract returns 92,208 superclass rows of which 16,178 are blank nodes and 3 are owl:Thing; without the filter iri_localname turned each blank node into a GOTerm whose identifier was its node id, adding 16k junk parents.  Restricting to the OBO namespace keeps legitimate cross-ontology parents (BFO, CARO), which still arrive as identifier-only stub items - filter harder if unwanted.
